page.layout: One printed page. Running head at the top. Three woodcut figures of bivalve shells, stacked one below another in the centre of the page, with no text beside them. Faint show-through from the reverse side in the lower right, not printed text.
page.notes: The page carries three woodcut illustrations of shells (top: a coiled, ribbed bivalve seen from the side; middle: a ribbed bivalve with its hinge at the top; bottom: a thick, concentric-ringed bivalve resting on a shaded base). They have no caption. The faint text fragments in the lower right are show-through from the reverse of the leaf and are not transcribed.
